Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

“Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even…
This is what the Lord Yahweh says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”
They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so…
For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will…
In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling…
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

translations.web: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
translations.bsb: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,
translations.kjv: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
translations.asv: Thy take crafty counsel against thy people, And consult together against thy hidden ones.
